investigation_notes.Description: An attempt to delete the Azure virtual network 'vnet-tallinn-test-01' was initiated by an account with Owner privileges. The action originated from IP 102.89.1.20 geolocated to Lagos, Nigeria, while the account belongs to an internal IT System Administrator (authenticated with FIDO/MFA). Because this is a high-impact network deletion from an atypical geography despite strong authentication, the activity is considered suspicious and merits immediate escalation and investigation.
